readiness_and_dependencies.native: All rank-local weight homes initialized by constructor before generate. A selected load_weight call reads only local immutable weights; selected rank0/1 packages have no data edge between them. Native normal-loop issue time is later and differs: rank1 receives rank0 activation before its layer loop, and each selected MLP needs earlier local attention computation before consumption. Thus source does not prove naturally simultaneous selected MLP loads.
readiness_and_dependencies.projection_M0: Both rank package source bytes initialized and visible; both destination allocations distinct, empty and reserved; both physical requesters idle; mappings/permissions accepted; descriptors prepared. M0 is an explicitly extracted eager operand-preparation phase before later rank computation. Count preparation/allocation/map/warmup/CPU-cache cost from an earlier end-to-end start; do not erase them by reporting only M0.
no_cross_role_edge: R0 full pipeline stage -> R1 input activation (outside selected preparation phase)
readiness_and_dependencies.per_tensor_ready: all actual DMA jobs covering exactly that tensor complete, no errors, visibility/cache ownership transfer done; descriptor publication alone is insufficient
readiness_and_dependencies.joint_ready: R0-ready AND R1-ready AND zero outstanding; one role completion cannot substitute for joint completion
readiness_and_dependencies.retention: Keep source immutable, keep destination live for later local MLP consumption through final microbatch or explicit fixture verification; no early reuse.
source_to_projection_adaptation: Extract and advance two selected MLP operand-load calls; native load times/overlap remain unclaimed.
Replace two CUDA targets by distinct existing-FPGA DDR destination ranges; replace source transfer engines by two existing physical iDMA devices.
Split each tensor into tensor-local <=4096B jobs for current existing diagnostic path; no job crosses tensor boundary. Actual six whole-tensor CUDA copies become 2309 iDMA jobs per role.
No consumer compute timing, artificial deadline, endless stream, storage relay or CUDA-stream-as-DID mapping.

preconditions: Config/environment established; per-rank CUDA compute object exists; uncompressed weight_load_dst equals local compute device.
Six CPU pinned weight_home tensors initialized, immutable and individually ready.

Empty per-layer weight_read_buf ValueHolder exists; smart_copy allocates nonresident destination tensors, allocation included in total cost. FPGA may reserve corresponding DDR destinations before M0, an explicit adapter difference.
k=0 invokes all six copies. k>0 intentionally performs no load and cannot substitute for the selected cold preparation.
exact_extracted_call.negative_evidence: Direct read of MLP.load_weight at flex_opt.py:497–505 proves its body references only weight_home, k, weight_load_dst, compute and weight_read_buf. No hidden activation, Task, cache or attention-mask value is used; MLP __init at462–470 sets these destinations without activation. Native wrapper timing remains distinct.
exact_extracted_call.activation_gate: MLP.forward at519–533 separately uses hidden.val and all six prepared weights; activation is a consumption precondition, not a selected load operation precondition.

mandatory_with_selected_initial_state: Each rank has a different assigned layer (0 vs6); each MLP consumes its six full tensors. With CPU homes and nonresident CUDA targets, each selected smart_copy must materialize its own target package.

Direct CPU-home/DDR-source -> rank-local target needs both roles and retains 18,895,872B of useful transfers. Removing the second role leaves rank1 selected MLP operands unavailable; routing both roles through one device is a different schedule, not object elimination.
skippable_or_alternative: A weight already resident at its destination uses identity smart_copy, no repeated transfer.

OPT125m easily fitting a GPU is not evidence offloading is necessary; GPU-resident placement is allowed and may replace later reloads. CPU-offload policy chosen here is a supported path, not a proven memory constraint.
Persistent local target residency can avoid repeated iterations; this card measures exactly one cold target preparation and must charge any previous equivalent copy.
Disk page faults, CPU relay and rank0->rank1 weight handoff are absent.
Other model weights, embeddings, attention/KV/activations and all compute are omitted because this is only a selected preparation phase; they cannot be called complete two-rank inference.
Inter-rank activation transfer is mandatory for actual pipeline execution, but outside this subphase; no fake timing or dependency added to the finite weight-copy phase.
mandatory_vs_skippable.initial_state_authority: For this finite phase both rank source packages are already CPU-pinned/initialized and both rank-local target copies are absent/empty before preparation. Changing GPU-resident initial state or doing copies before timing can remove timed work only if that preparation is reported and charged; it does not show either output object is unnecessary.

fpga_projection.native_topology_claim: No source evidence these native GPUs share an IOMMU. Paper evaluation uses four different machines; source allows GPU communication/cpu socket. Do not transplant native topology.
fpga_projection.defined_projection: Two actual physical existing iDMA requesters each own one complete operand package and direct-copy it to distinct DDR destination ranges behind the existing shared RISC-V IOMMU. Requester identity and DID values must be verified by root in the accepted platform binding.
fpga_projection.sources: two independently named DDR CPU-prepared source packages
fpga_projection.destinations: two distinct DDR buffers standing for rank-local GPU allocations
fpga_projection.data: Numerical model weights/revision not acquired. Distinct deterministic per-rank fixtures may validate transfer object identity and byte preservation only, without AI numerical accuracy.
fpga_projection.mapping: Separate role IOVA source read permissions and destination write permissions under stable contexts; real shared translation hardware verified by platform seat/root. Shared context/physical placement alternatives allowed if lawful and equivalent.
fpga_projection.allocation: 4KiB tensor-start alignment retains exact bytes and needs 37,830,656B across two source and two destination sets. 48MiB payload reserve arithmetic permits it; Linux allocation/CPU-cache/page-table/guard/descriptor/completion costs are additional and unverified.
fpga_projection.large_pages: Conditional 2MiB control: round each complete source/destination region to10MiB (40MiB total) using real aligned contiguous backing and supported mappings, preserve true tensor byte/jobs and count padding. Do not assume Linux allocated such backing or the private harness can map it without root check.

ordinary_baselines.method: Direct 4KiB tensor-local copy all R0 objects then all R1, using two physical roles and same mappings/budget; retain all data/checks. Serial order may be chosen by complete-phase objective, no made-up deadlines.

Direct copies on both physical roles with stable mappings; issue under actual frontend capacity/backpressure and measure each completion, tensor/role/joint-ready and errors; native CUDA streams are not separate identities.

Allow the original twelve full-tensor direct copies when actual normal iDMA length/segmentation and shared-IOMMU path permit them. Do not force 4KiB job splitting on ordinary controls merely to expose translation interference. Count crossings/completions and exact tensor byte coverage; 4KiB private jobs are a transport fixture option, not native task count.

Allocate and map both whole packages before M0, legally translate/prewarm or prepare physical cached ranges when platform supports; include this in end-to-end cost. Permit ordinary eager per-rank operand copy and persistent target residency; source does not forbid these optimizations.
Use 2MiB mappings only if actually supported/aligned/backed under same48MiB payload budget. Compare useful work, source/destination identity and joint completion, not descriptor/page-count fiction.

If task API permits one device to copy both distinct packages, count it as legal ordinary scheduling control with same total work and endpoints. Two roles are native independent consumers; allocating one iDMA per role is a defined experimental binding, not source proof both copy engines must be used.

Linux actual buffer allocations, mapping/granularity, cache transfer, MMIO submission/supply and teardown cost still need platform acceptance; imported stage105 RTL copy proof is reusable asset, not new two-role workload execution evidence.
Root must decide whether source-derived eager-weight preparation remains materially useful after legal stable mappings/large pages/eager complete preparation/single-device scheduling controls.

bounded_entry_verdict.accept_if: Root accepts conditional eager preparation projection with two distinct complete packages, actual identity/memory/cache/API bindings, all completion costs, and a bounded ordinary-control comparison that can reveal shared-IOMMU behavior without pretending source GPUs shared it.
bounded_entry_verdict.reject_if: Claim requires native simultaneous selected-layer load, compulsory CPU offload because OPT125m cannot fit, mandatory use of two copy engines, native shared-IOMMU deployment, full inference correctness/throughput, or omits legal preprepare/residency/large-page/direct controls.
bounded_entry_verdict.next: One bounded direct complete-two-package G0 check after static acceptance; stop or redesign if legal ordinary preparation/large-page/mapping scheduling covers the objective. No third scenario generated.
